original.statement: Bug fix: the default servers transport SPIFFE configuration is now enforced (details of before/after not stated).

decision.reason: [ev-57c05cdbb7d0] is a bug-fix changelog entry under [tls,service] saying the default servers transport's SPIFFE config is now enforced. That means the same configuration now behaves differently at runtime (it is honoured in TLS to backends), so behavior-changed is the right type. The excerpt names no config key, field or flag, so a TLS-level protocol-behavior subject named from the evidence's own words (default-servers-transport-spiffe) is the closest identity it supports. The validator results are inconclusive, so they neither support nor contradict this, and I have no before/after literals.
